Method of Attack: Uses remote port forwarding via Secure Shell (SSH) tunnels to hide malicious traffic and grant attackers access to firewall-protected networks
Creates an SSH tunnel to allow attackers access to internal company networks (MilkyDoor)
Evades Google's Play Store security scans
Uses infected devices as relay points to escalate access to internal company servers, launch attacks, and steal data
Hides malicious traffic behind encrypted SSH tunnels to bypass network monitoring and firewall restrictions
Attack Vector: Android apps distributed via Google Play Store
Indicators of Compromise: Over 200 infected Android applications removed from Google Play Store
Apps had between 500,000 and 1 million installs through Play Store
Malware found in repackaged versions of various games and children books
